recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not restore the older patient-genderIdentity core source or FHIR-local gender-identity code system unless PA/Gender Harmony makes a new decision to change the canonical extension model or move Extension Pack content back into core.
issue_request: FHIR-13843 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 Patient issue from PA asking for genderIdentity on Patient, resolved as a standard Patient extension with CodeableConcept 0..1, the final definition "The gender the patient identifies with. The Patient's gender identity is used as guidance (e.g. for staff) about how to interact with the patient", and an example binding.
initial_application: Commit 077d81592c8698f6f9c06636c93fe18e23a51082, titled "GF#13843: add gender-identity extension", initially applied the issue by adding Patient gender identity terminology and updating the then-current Patient extension spreadsheet.
additional_context: Later PA/Gender Harmony work intentionally changed the artifact shape: FHIR-29673 generalized genderIdentity to individual-genderIdentity for Patient and other person resources, FHIR-39202 removed the openly-known note from the Patient text, FHIR-38639 removed the old FHIR gender-identity code system after the value set moved to THO/SNOMED content, and FHIR-46412 added genderIdentity search support in the Extensions IG. The old patient-genderIdentity artifact is now retired/deprecated in the Extension Pack, while the active individual-genderIdentity extension is maintained there.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No FHIR-core source edit is needed because Patient is build-scoped, source/patient/patient-notes.xml links to individual-genderIdentity and pronouns, source/patient/patient-example-sex-and-gender.xml uses individual-genderIdentity, and source/patient/list-Patient-examples.xml registers that example.
